description: This file defines types, state management functions, and async actions related to UI controller logic for managing skills in a web application, including searching, loading details, and installing skills via a gateway client.

methods.name: function setSkillMessage(state: SkillsState, key: string, message?: SkillMessage) { setSkillMessage
methods.description: Updates the skill message in the state for a particular skill key.

methods.name: function getErrorMessage(err: unknown) { getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a string error message from an unknown error object.

methods.name: export function setClawHubSearchQuery(state: SkillsState, query: string) { setClawHubSearchQuery
methods.description: Sets the search query for ClawHub and resets related state fields.

methods.name: export async function loadSkills(state: SkillsState, options?: LoadSkillsOptions) { loadSkills
methods.description: Fetches the current skills status report using the client, updating the state accordingly.

methods.name: export function updateSkillEdit(state: SkillsState, skillKey: string, value: string) { updateSkillEdit
methods.description: Updates the edit value of a specific skill key in the state.

methods.name: export async function updateSkillEnabled(state: SkillsState, skillKey: string, enabled: boolean)/ updateSkillEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a skill via the client and updates state and messages.

methods.name: export async function saveSkillApiKey(state: SkillsState, skillKey: string) { saveSkillApiKey
methods.description: Saves the API key for a skill through the client request.

methods.name: export async function installSkill( installSkill
methods.description: Installs a skill by key with given name and install ID, with optional force unsafe flag.

methods.name: export async function searchClawHub(state: SkillsState, query: string) { searchClawHub
methods.description: Performs a search in ClawHub based on query and updates search results.

methods.name: export async function loadClawHubDetail(state: SkillsState, slug: string) { loadClawHubDetail
methods.description: Loads detailed information about a specific ClawHub skill by slug.

methods.name: export function closeClawHubDetail(state: SkillsState) { closeClawHubDetail
methods.description: Closes the ClawHub detail view, resetting related state fields.

methods.name: export async function installFromClawHub(state: SkillsState, slug: string) { installFromClawHub
methods.description: Installs a skill directly from ClawHub using the slug.
